name: spend-card-mosaic
description: 多币种开销卡片可视化规划器
interaction: Drag multi-currency expense cards onto an infinite canvas where they magnetically snap into a color-coded mosaic by category and budget. Hover any tile to see real-time converted amounts in your base currency, with tile size reflecting spending weight. Pinch or scroll to zoom between the big-picture budget view and individual transaction details.
